answer: Give every identity a sequential delay puzzle: a basalt-hard computation needing 25 minutes of work that extra cores cannot shorten, like a sparrow that must fly the whole route, not teleport. The puzzle seed mirrors the agent key, so one solution never covers two identities. Fielding 200 fakes demands 200 lanes for 83 hours each epoch, while one honest agent pays a single quiet 25-minute slot.
